children: Philip Morris International reported revenue of $11.44 billion and net income of $3.31 billion for the quarter, while diluted EPS was $2.12. Revenue increased 5.5% year over year, while net income and EPS declined 4.7% and 4.9%, respectively.
¹ Reported as “Net revenues 1 & 2 (Note 13)”. ² Reported as “Net earnings attributable to PMI”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Nine-month net revenue rose 8.2% to $32.8 billion; growth excluding currency and acquisitions was 5.9%, supported by pricing and international smoke-free volumes.
Smoke-free shipments increased 6.4%, while cigarette shipments declined 1.2%. The company’s full-year outlook calls for high-single-digit smoke-free shipment growth.
International IQOS shipment volume rose 6.7% year to date. Adjusted heated tobacco unit sales grew broadly, particularly outside Japan and Poland.
U.S. ZYN shipments grew 4.2% in the third quarter but fell 6.0% year to date. New product launches and 20-pouch cans are expected to bring added investment and near-term revenue pressure.
The FDA authorized 11 ZYN ULTRA products and modified-risk claims for 20 ZYN varieties. IQOS smoke-free products are now sold in 110 markets.
